name: h2_sum_cubes
statement: ∀ n : Nat, sumCube n * 4 = (n * (n + 1)) * (n * (n + 1))
prelude:
@[simp] def sumCube : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n+1 => sumCube n + (n+1)*(n+1)*(n+1)

  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp only [sumCube]; grind

name: h2_sum_acc
statement: ∀ l : List Nat, sumAcc l 0 = l.sum
prelude:
def sumAcc : List Nat → Nat → Nat
  | [], acc => acc
  | x :: xs, acc => sumAcc xs (acc + x)
gold:
have h : ∀ (l : List Nat) (acc : Nat), sumAcc l acc = acc + l.sum := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro acc; simp [sumAcc]
    | cons x xs ih => intro acc; simp [sumAcc, ih]; omega

name: h2_compile_correct
statement: ∀ e : Expr, exec (compile e) [] = [eval e]
prelude:
inductive Expr where
  | const : Nat → Expr
  | plus : Expr → Expr → Expr
  | times : Expr → Expr → Expr

def eval : Expr → Nat
  | .const n => n
  | .plus a b => eval a + eval b
  | .times a b => eval a * eval b

inductive Instr where
  | push : Nat → Instr
  | add : Instr
  | mul : Instr

def exec : List Instr → List Nat → List Nat
  | [], s => s
  | .push n :: is, s => exec is (n :: s)
  | .add :: is, b :: a :: s => exec is ((a + b) :: s)
  | .mul :: is, b :: a :: s => exec is ((a * b) :: s)
  | _ :: is, s => exec is s

def compile : Expr → List Instr
  | .const n => [.push n]
  | .plus a b => compile a ++ compile b ++ [.add]
  | .times a b => compile a ++ compile b ++ [.mul]
gold:
have h : ∀ (e : Expr) (is : List Instr) (s : List Nat), exec (compile e ++ is) s = exec is (eval e :: s) := by
    intro e
    induction e with
    | const n => intro is s; simp [compile, exec, eval]
    | plus a b iha ihb => intro is s; simp [compile, List.append_assoc, iha, ihb, exec, eval]
    | times a b iha ihb => intro is s; simp [compile, List.append_assoc, iha, ihb, exec, eval]

name: h2_isort_length
statement: ∀ l : List Nat, (isort l).length = l.length
prelude:
def ins (x : Nat) : List Nat → List Nat
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys => if x ≤ y then x :: y :: ys else y :: ins x ys

def isort : List Nat → List Nat
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => ins x (isort xs)
gold:
have h : ∀ (x : Nat) (l : List Nat), (ins x l).length = l.length + 1 := by
    intro x l
    induction l with
    | nil => simp [ins]
    | cons y ys ih => simp only [ins]; split <;> simp [ih]

induction l with
  | nil => simp [isort]
  | cons x xs ih => simp [isort, h, ih]

name: h2_isort_sorted
statement: ∀ l : List Nat, Sorted (isort l)
prelude:
def ins (x : Nat) : List Nat → List Nat
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys => if x ≤ y then x :: y :: ys else y :: ins x ys

def isort : List Nat → List Nat
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => ins x (isort xs)

def Sorted : List Nat → Prop
  | [] => True
  | [_] => True
  | a :: b :: rest => a ≤ b ∧ Sorted (b :: rest)
gold:
have hd : ∀ (x y : Nat) (l : List Nat), y < x → Sorted (y :: l) → Sorted (y :: ins x l) := by
    intro x y l
    induction l generalizing y with
    | nil => intro h _; simp [ins, Sorted]; omega
    | cons z zs ih =>
      intro h hs
      simp only [Sorted] at hs
      simp only [ins]
      split
      · simp only [Sorted]; exact ⟨by omega, by omega, hs.2⟩
      · exact ⟨hs.1, ih z (by omega) hs.2⟩

have hi : ∀ (x : Nat) (l : List Nat), Sorted l → Sorted (ins x l) := by
    intro x l hs
    cases l with
    | nil => simp [ins, Sorted]
    | cons y ys =>
      simp only [ins]
      split
      · exact ⟨by omega, hs⟩
      · exact hd x y ys (by omega) hs

induction l with
  | nil => simp [isort, Sorted]
  | cons x xs ih => exact hi x _ ih

name: h2_fib_coprime
statement: ∀ n : Nat, Nat.gcd (fib n) (fib (n + 1)) = 1
prelude:
def fib : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 1
  | n+2 => fib n + fib (n+1)
gold:
induction n with
  | zero => simp [fib]
  | succ k ih =>
    have e : fib (k + 1 + 1) = fib k + fib (k + 1) := by simp [fib]
    rw [e, Nat.gcd_comm, Nat.gcd_add_self_left]
    exact ih

name: h2_fib_add
statement: ∀ m n : Nat, fib (m + n + 1) = fib m * fib n + fib (m + 1) * fib (n + 1)
prelude:
def fib : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 1
  | n+2 => fib n + fib (n+1)
gold:
induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => simp [fib]
  | succ k ih =>
    have h1 := ih (m + 1)
    have e1 : m + 1 + k + 1 = m + (k + 1) + 1 := by omega
    have e2 : fib (m + 1 + 1) = fib m + fib (m + 1) := by simp [fib]
    have e3 : fib (k + 1 + 1) = fib k + fib (k + 1) := by simp [fib]
    rw [e1, e2] at h1
    rw [h1, e3]
    grind

name: h2_six_dvd_consec
gold: rcases h with h | h | h | h | h | h <;> simp [Nat.dvd_iff_mod_eq_zero, Nat.mul_mod, Nat.add_mod, h]

name: h2_sq_le_two_pow
statement: ∀ n : Nat, 4 ≤ n → n * n ≤ 2 ^ n
gold:
induction n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ k ih =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k 4 with hk | hk
    · have : k = 3 := by omega
      subst this; decide
    · have h1 := ih hk
      have h2 : 2 * k + 1 ≤ k * k := by
        have : 4 * k ≤ k * k := Nat.mul_le_mul_right k hk
        omega
      rw [Nat.pow_succ]
      grind

name: h2_is_even
statement: ∀ n : Nat, isEven n = (n % 2 == 0)
prelude:
def isEven : Nat → Bool
  | 0 => true
  | 1 => false
  | n+2 => isEven n
gold:
induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ n ih =>
    match n with
    | 0 => rfl
    | 1 => rfl
    | k + 2 =>
      rw [isEven, ih k (by omega)]
      have : (k + 2) % 2 = k % 2 := by omega
      rw [this]

name: h2_ack_gt
statement: ∀ m n : Nat, n < ack m n
prelude:
def ack : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, n => n + 1
  | m+1, 0 => ack m 1
  | m+1, n+1 => ack m (ack (m+1) n)
gold:
induction m with
  | zero => intro n; simp [ack]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp only [ack]; have := ih 1; omega
    | succ j ihj => simp only [ack]; have := ih (ack (k + 1) j); omega

name: h2_count_isort
statement: ∀ (x : Nat) (l : List Nat), count x (isort l) = count x l
prelude:
def ins (x : Nat) : List Nat → List Nat
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys => if x ≤ y then x :: y :: ys else y :: ins x ys

def isort : List Nat → List Nat
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => ins x (isort xs)

def count (x : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | y :: ys => (if x = y then 1 else 0) + count x ys
gold:
have h : ∀ (x y : Nat) (l : List Nat), count x (ins y l) = (if x = y then 1 else 0) + count x l := by
    intro x y l
    induction l with
    | nil => simp [ins, count]
    | cons z zs ih => simp only [ins]; split <;> simp only [count, ih] <;> omega

induction l with
  | nil => simp [isort]
  | cons y ys ih => simp only [isort, count, h, ih]

  | [] => 0

name: h2_ack_succ
statement: ∀ m n : Nat, ack m n < ack m (n + 1)
prelude:
def ack : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, n => n + 1
  | m+1, 0 => ack m 1
  | m+1, n+1 => ack m (ack (m+1) n)
gold:
have gt : ∀ m n : Nat, n < ack m n := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intro n; simp [ack]
    | succ k ih =>
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => simp only [ack]; have := ih 1; omega
      | succ j ihj => simp only [ack]; have := ih (ack (k + 1) j); omega

cases m with
  | zero => simp [ack]
  | succ k => simp only [ack]; exact gt k _

name: h2_isort_idem
statement: ∀ l : List Nat, isort (isort l) = isort l
prelude:
def ins (x : Nat) : List Nat → List Nat
  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys => if x ≤ y then x :: y :: ys else y :: ins x ys

def isort : List Nat → List Nat
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => ins x (isort xs)

def Sorted : List Nat → Prop
  | [] => True
  | [_] => True
  | a :: b :: rest => a ≤ b ∧ Sorted (b :: rest)
gold:
have hd : ∀ (x y : Nat) (l : List Nat), y < x → Sorted (y :: l) → Sorted (y :: ins x l) := by
    intro x y l
    induction l generalizing y with
    | nil => intro h _; simp [ins, Sorted]; omega
    | cons z zs ih =>
      intro h hs
      simp only [Sorted] at hs
      simp only [ins]
      split
      · simp only [Sorted]; exact ⟨by omega, by omega, hs.2⟩
      · exact ⟨hs.1, ih z (by omega) hs.2⟩

have hi : ∀ (x : Nat) (l : List Nat), Sorted l → Sorted (ins x l) := by
    intro x l hs
    cases l with
    | nil => simp [ins, Sorted]
    | cons y ys =>
      simp only [ins]
      split
      · exact ⟨by omega, hs⟩
      · exact hd x y ys (by omega) hs

have hsorted : ∀ l : List Nat, Sorted (isort l) := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => simp [isort, Sorted]
    | cons x xs ih => exact hi x _ ih

have htail : ∀ (x : Nat) (l : List Nat), Sorted (x :: l) → Sorted l := by
    intro x l h
    cases l with
    | nil => simp [Sorted]
    | cons y ys => exact h.2

have hins : ∀ (x : Nat) (l : List Nat), Sorted (x :: l) → ins x l = x :: l := by
    intro x l h
    cases l with
    | nil => simp [ins]
    | cons y ys => simp only [ins]; rw [if_pos h.1]

have hfix : ∀ l : List Nat, Sorted l → isort l = l := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro _; simp [isort]
    | cons x xs ih => intro h; simp only [isort]; rw [ih (htail x xs h)]; exact hins x xs h

name: h2_fib_lt_two_pow
statement: ∀ n : Nat, fib n < 2 ^ n
prelude:
def fib : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 1
  | n+2 => fib n + fib (n+1)
gold:
have h : ∀ n : Nat, fib n < 2 ^ n ∧ fib (n + 1) < 2 ^ (n + 1) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp [fib]
    | succ k ih =>
      refine ⟨ih.2, ?_⟩
      have e : fib (k + 2) = fib k + fib (k + 1) := by simp [fib]
      have p : 2 ^ (k + 2) = 2 ^ (k + 1) + 2 ^ (k + 1) := by rw [Nat.pow_succ]; omega
      have q : 2 ^ k ≤ 2 ^ (k + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
      rw [e, p]
      omega

name: h2_prod_acc
statement: ∀ l : List Nat, prodAcc l 1 = prodL l
prelude:
def prodL : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 1
  | x :: xs => x * prodL xs

def prodAcc : List Nat → Nat → Nat
  | [], acc => acc
  | x :: xs, acc => prodAcc xs (acc * x)
gold:
have h : ∀ (l : List Nat) (acc : Nat), prodAcc l acc = acc * prodL l := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => intro acc; simp [prodAcc, prodL]
    | cons x xs ih => intro acc; simp only [prodAcc, prodL, ih, Nat.mul_assoc]

name: h2_fast_fib
statement: ∀ n : Nat, fibAux n 0 1 = fib n
prelude:
def fib : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 1
  | n+2 => fib n + fib (n+1)

def fibAux : Nat → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, a, _ => a
  | n+1, a, b => fibAux n b (a + b)
gold:
have h : ∀ n k : Nat, fibAux n (fib k) (fib (k + 1)) = fib (n + k) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => intro k; simp [fibAux]
    | succ m ih =>
      intro k
      have e : fib k + fib (k + 1) = fib (k + 1 + 1) := by simp [fib]
      simp only [fibAux]
      rw [e, ih (k + 1)]
      congr 1
      omega
